intro: The doctor has given you medicine. Ask how to take it.

conversation.speaker: doctor
conversation.text: Here is your medicine. Take it carefully.

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Ask how many times a day you should take it.
expected: How many times a day should I take it?
How many times should I take this?
How often should I take it?
conversation.hint: Try: "How many times a day should I take it?"

conversation.speaker: doctor
conversation.text: Twice a day, morning and night.

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Ask whether to take it before or after food.
expected: Should I take it after food?
Do I take it before food?
conversation.hint: Try: "Should I take it after food?"

conversation.speaker: doctor
conversation.text: Always after food. Never on an empty stomach.

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Ask how many days you must take it.
expected: How many days should I take it?
How long do I take it?

conversation.speaker: doctor
conversation.text: For five days. Come back if you still feel unwell.

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Say that you understand the instructions.

conversation.speaker: doctor
conversation.text: Good. Rest well and drink plenty of water.

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Thank the doctor and say goodbye.
